Leatherback Turtle
Background:
•　Average length at maturity: 1.8 metres
•　The advantageous helps movement in the sea water.
•　It is the only reptile that can to 1,200 meters deep.
•　Its shell is so it can endure pressure.
•　It can live in hot Caribbean and cold water in Canada.
•　It can on the water for several hours.
•　It eats food which is high in and mineral.
Research Project methods:
•　Scientists study their in the Atlantic Ocean.
•　Tracking device can start transmitting when the turtle reaches the of the sea.
•　The device is only switched on when transmitting signals in order to avoid running out of .
•　Scientists can monitor the of the turtles in the sea even though the device is turned off.
•　Linda had no damage and crack in her shell or flippers, yet it used much searching food.

analyses.content: 录音中直接提到了“advantageous shape”非常适合它们在水中移动（move in water），与题目完美对应。
你可能会听到前面的“rubbery”或“shell”，但要注意题目问的是帮助移动的“advantageous（有优势的）”什么东西，只有shape（形状）符合语义。
Leatherback turtles have a rubbery, dark shell which is marked by 7 narrow ridges that extend at the length of their backs. This advantageous shape is perfect for them to move in water.
录音指出它们能“dive（潜水）”到1200米深，且没有其他爬行动物能潜这么深，填入dive符合语法和题意。
不要因为听到后面的“go that deep”就想填go，题目中can后面需要填入一个具体的动作，dive是最准确的答案。

They are known to dive to 1200 meters under seas to pursue their prey, which means they have very good lungs to allow them to hold their breath for a very long time underwater. There are no other turtles or reptiles that can go that deep.
录音明确解释了它们能承受水压（stand the pressure）是因为它们的壳是“soft（柔软的）”。
你可能会听到“bony（骨质的）”，但那是其他海龟的特征，一定要注意录音里的“unlike（不同于）”这个转折信号。

They can stand the pressure from the water above because, unlike other turtles which have bony shells, their shells are soft. This is also one of the most distinctive characteristics of leatherback turtles. Their shells can endure the pressure and avoid being cracked.
录音提到它们累了时会在水面上“sleep（睡觉）”几个小时（a couple of hours对应several hours）。
容易错填成前面出现的float，但录音在对应时间段（several hours）给出的具体动作是sleep。
Sometimes, when they are tired, they just sleep on the water for a couple of hours, and the ocean current can take them forward.
录音提到它们吃的主要是水母，而水母含有很高的“protein（蛋白质）”和mineral（矿物质）。
不要填成jellyfish，因为题目问的是食物里富含什么物质（high in...），而不是食物本身。
Leatherback turtles feed almost entirely on jellyfish. Jellyfish is very high in protein and mineral, so it could offer the turtles a lot of energy and calories.
录音直接交代了科学家做实验是为了研究它们在大西洋的“migration（迁徙）”特征。原词是 migration features，这里的核心词是 migration，所以可以直接填 migration，不能填宽泛的 features。
你可能听到了habits（习惯），但它对应的是总体研究目的，具体在Atlantic Ocean研究的核心特征是migration。  并且原文的 study 明确对应题目中的 study。

Scientists have been researching leatherback turtles for many years in order to know more about the habits of this interesting sea creature. To study the migration features of leatherback turtles in the Atlantic Ocean, scientists did an experiment.
录音指出，每当海龟到达海面（the surface of the sea）呼吸时，追踪设备就会发送信号。
听到laboratory不要急着填，要听清题目问的是海龟到达“海洋的什么位置（the ___ of the sea）”时开始传输。
The working mechanism is like this. The kind of tracking device can transmit signals back to the laboratory whenever this turtle reaches the surface of the sea to breathe.
录音解释设备按需开关是为了防止“running out of power（耗尽电量）”。
不要因为听到signals就填进去，题目问的是避免耗尽（running out of）什么东西，逻辑上是避免没电（power）。

The tracking devices will be switched off when the sea turtle is underwater, and they will be automatically switched on for transmitting the signals when the turtle comes out of the water. This could prevent the device from running out of power since the devices will stay with the turtles for several months.
录音说明即使设备在水下关闭，也能测量海龟在水中的“depth（深度）”。
你可能会填location（位置），但录音原话是“the depth of the turtle's location”，核心测量的数值是深度。
The good thing about this device is that even though it is turned off underwater, it can measure the depth of the turtle's location in the sea and send the data back to the scientists.
题目的“used much”对应录音的“use a lot of”，后面紧跟的就是正确答案“energy（能量）”来寻找食物。
容易被后面的body size（体型）干扰，但要注意填入的内容必须是可以被“使用（used/use）”去寻找食物的东西。

Scientists found no damage or crack on her shell or flippers, which may indicate that leatherback turtles like Linda have few natural predators once they are mature. However, the data also showed that it needed to use a lot of energy to search for food in the sea, partly because of its big body size.
